description: This Java class 'EdgeDataValidator' extends 'DataValidator' to perform validation logic for 'Edge' entities, including checks for tenant existence, customer assignment, and required fields.

classes.name: EdgeDataValidator
classes.description: A validator class for 'Edge' entities, ensuring data integrity and consistency before database operations.

methods.description: Validates creation of an Edge, checking the number of entities per tenant.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates update operation by retrieving existing Edge by ID.
